explanation: The derivative is dL/dw = 2(w − 3). At w = 0 it is −6, so the first step moves to 0 − 0.1 · (−6) = 0.6. At w = 0.6 it is −4.8, so the second step moves to 0.6 + 0.48 = 1.08. Each step closes 20% of the remaining gap to 3, which is why the second step is shorter than the first; stepping along the derivative instead of against it would walk away from the minimum.
